Node available hai — actual syntax check chala sakta hoon.Chaar alag-alag issues hain — do (3D + language) ka root cause connected lag raha hai, baaki do (text overflow, AI naam) fully diagnose ho gaye hain code se. Detail: ## 1 & 2. 3D hand nahi dikh raha + English choose karne par bhi Hindi dikh raha hai Maine `app.js`, `mainUI.js`, `hand3DViewer.js` ko line-by-line static check kiya — **code logic khud sahi hai:** - Render loop (`requestAnimationFrame` + `renderer.render`) sahi jagah hai, missing nahi - Script tags (Three.js, OrbitControls, GLTFLoader, MediaPipe) sahi order me load ho rahe hain - i18n dictionary complete hai — HTML ke saare `data-i18n` keys `en`/`hi`/`hin` teeno dictionaries me match karte hain, koi missing key nahi - `node --check` se saari JS files me koi syntax error nahi - Koi duplicate HTML `id` nahi (jo `getElementById` ko galat element pakadwa de) **Jab code static-check me sahi dikhta hai but browser me kuch bhi nahi chalta (na 3D, na language-switch), to sabse common wajah hoti hai: `js/app.js` ek ES module hai (`type="module"`), aur ye module poori tarah load hi nahi ho pa raha.** Agar tum `index.html` ko seedha double-click karke `file:///C:/...` se khol rahe ho (browser me localhost ki jagah), to browsers security ke liye **module scripts ko `file://` se block kar dete hain** — poora `app.js` silently fail ho jata hai, isliye 3D bhi nahi bante aur language selector ka click-listener bhi kabhi attach hi nahi hota (isliye dropdown me English "select" to ho jata hai, but page ka text update nahi hota). **Turant check karne ka tarika:** Browser me `F12` (DevTools) dabao → **Console tab** kholo → agar wahan koi **laal (red) error** dikh raha hai jisme "CORS", "module", ya "Failed to load module script" jaisa likha ho — to yahi confirm ho jayega. Ek sawal: **tum site ko kaise khol rahe ho — seedha `index.html` file par double-click karke, ya kisi local server (jaise `localhost:3000`, `python -m http.server`, `Live Server` extension) ke through?** Agar double-click wala case hai, to fix simple hai (local server se serve karo, code me kuch badalna nahi padega). Agar already server se chala rahe ho aur phir bhi problem hai, to Console ka exact error paste kar do — us hisaab se main real bug dhoondh ke fix dunga. ## 3. Text header box ke bahar ja raha hai — root cause mil gaya `.card-header` (jahan title + "Certified by 4 Classical Texts" jaisa badge saath dikhta hai) me `justify-content: space-between` hai but **`flex-wrap` set hi nahi hai**, aur title/badge dono ke paas koi shrink-safety nahi hai. Jab language English par jaati hai, English strings Hindi/Hinglish se lambi hoti hain (e.g. "Certified by 4 Classical Texts" Hindi wale se lamba hai) — isliye row ka total content box se bahar nikal jata hai instead of wrap hone ke. **Fix — `css/style.css` me:** ```css .card-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(223, 172, 108, 0.12); padding-bottom: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; /* NEW — jagah kam ho to badge neeche wrap ho jaye */ row-gap: 8px; } .card-header h2 { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--soft-white); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; /* NEW — flex item ko shrink karne do */ overflow-wrap: break-word; } .badge-shastra { /* ...existing properties... */ white-space: nowrap; /* NEW — badge khud na tute, poori tarah wrap ho */ flex-shrink: 0; } ``` Wahi pattern `.app-header` (top logo bar) me bhi hai — agar wahan bhi overflow dikhe (especially mobile par), same 3 properties (`flex-wrap: wrap` on parent, `min-width: 0` on title, `flex-shrink: 0` + `white-space: nowrap` on right-side group) waha bhi laga dena. ## 4. "AI" naam har jagah se hatana — poori list Maine sabhi files scan ki hain. Ye sab jagah "AI" likha hua hai: **User ko seedha dikhne wali jagah (high priority):** | Jagah | File | Current text | |---|---|---| | Browser tab title | `index.html` L6 | `AI Palmistry Pro - Multilingual...` | | Main logo (sabse upar) | `index.html` L68 | `

AI Palmistry Pro

` | | PWA install name (jab phone home-screen par install ho) | `manifest.json` L2 | `"name": "AI Palmistry Pro - ..."` | | PWA description | `manifest.json` L4 | `Enterprise Multilingual AI Palmistry...` | | Footer (teeno languages) | `mainUI.js` — `footer_text` keys | `© 2026 AI Palmistry Pro...` | | PWA banner text | `mainUI.js` — `pwa_title` keys (teeno languages) | `AI Palmistry Pro ऐप` / `App` | | 3D control button | `index.html` L407-408 | `"AI Heatmap Mode"` / `AI Heatmap` | | Reading result badge (result card ke andar) | `xaiEngine.js` L52,95,139 | `Explainable AI (XAI) Precision Certificate`, `Dynamic AI Confidence` | | PDF export title/footer/filename | `mainUI.js` L522,526,530 | `AI Palmistry Pro - Astrological Report`, `AI_Palmistry_Pro_Report.pdf` | | WhatsApp share message | `mainUI.js` L684 | `🖐️ AI Palmistry Pro द्वारा...` | **Sirf backend/developer-facing (kam priority, user kabhi nahi dekhta):** - `backend/fastapi/main.py` — FastAPI `title=` aur health-check response (sirf `/docs` Swagger page ya API response me dikhta hai) - Har JS file ke top comment ("AI Palmistry Pro - ...") aur class naam `XAIEngine`/variable `xai` — ye sirf code padhne wale ko dikhta hai, functionally koi fark nahi padta agar naam rakho ya hatao **Suggestion:** naya brand naam decide karo (e.g. sirf "Palmistry Pro" ya "Samudrik Shastra Pro" ya jo bhi socha ho), phir main exact find-replace list bana ke de sakta hoon taaki tumhara coding agent ek hi pass me sab jagah (high-priority wali 11 jagah) consistently replace kar de — kya naya naam rakhna chahte ho?
